page_title: ROM 1-1 NAP | AS Roma v Napoli 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is behind the touchline and AS Roma will take a throw-in.
90+2' 1 - 1 Amazing piece of skill! Angelino (AS Roma) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is!
90+2' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
87' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Giovanni Simeone. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
86' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Matteo Politano will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
85' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
83' The players claim that Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Napoli have a free kick.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replaces Romelu Lukaku.
80' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Devyne Rensch and he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Eldor Shomurodov will be replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
78' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will take a throw-in.
78' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' That will be all from David Neres who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
75' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
74' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
70' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
69' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
69' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) works the corner short.
68' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
67' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) tries to find Artem Dovbyk, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

65' Close! Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
64' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) replacing Bryan Cristante.
63' David Neres (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. AS Roma have been awarded a free kick.

61' Angelino (AS Roma) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

60' Matteo Politano (Napoli) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
59' A pass into the penalty area from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
58' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
56' Manu Kone just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) replaces him.
55' Substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) has come on for Stephan El Shaarawy.
54' Manu Kone (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Manu Kone (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for infringement.

50' The ball rebounds out to Scott McTominay (Napoli) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
48' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

47' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+1' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. AS Roma will take a corner kick.

44' AS Roma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
43' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
42' David Neres (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
42' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
40' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
36' Matias Soule (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
35' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
32' Scott McTominay (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' 0 - 1 GOAL! Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Mile Svilar, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:1.
28' Matias Soule (AS Roma) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
27' David Neres (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
25' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) superbly rides the challenge and bends a shot in from distance that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

23' Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
23' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
22' The ball is cleared after Scott McTominay (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
20' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
19' Napoli are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' That's a clear yellow card. Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes into the book.
13' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
11' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
9' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
8' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
7' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
2' Wonderful movement by AS Roma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will officiate today.
